title: Large Language Models Extend Known Research But Do Not Create New Research Directions
abstract: arXiv:2610.17439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The success of autonomous research systems relies on the quality of the scientific hypotheses they generate. Recent studies report that human reviewers often rate LLM-generated ideas as more novel than those from human experts, raising hope that AI can accelerate scientific discovery. Yet it is unclear whether these models can do more than extend existing knowledge. Can LLMs drive genuine innovation by revealing new research directions, or are they limited to repeating and recombining what science already knows? This unresolved question lies at the heart of discussions about AI and the future of science. To address this, we distinguish two types of novelty: distance, which measures how far a hypothesis lies from existing work, and direction, which captures whether the hypothesis pursues new lines of inquiry beyond those already present. translated_title: 大语言模型能够扩展已知研究，但无法创造新的研究方向
translated_abstract: 自主研究系统的成功依赖于其生成的科学假设的质量。近期研究显示，人类评审往往认为大语言模型（LLM）生成的想法比人类专家的想法更具新颖性，这让人们寄希望于AI能够加速科学发现。然而，尚不清楚这些模型是否能做到超越扩展现有知识的程度：大语言模型能否通过揭示新的研究方向来推动真正的创新，还是仅限于重复和重新组合科学界已知的内容？这一悬而未决的问题正处于关于AI与科学未来讨论的核心。为解决这一问题，我们区分了两种类型的新颖性：距离，衡量一个假设与现有工作之间的差距；方向，衡量该假设是否开辟了现有研究之外的新探索路线。对于大语言模型生成的工作，这两种度量表现出显著分歧。我们将科学论文表示在一个共享的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出区分科学新颖性的“距离”与“方向”两种度量方式，发现大语言模型生成的研究虽然表面上具有新颖性，但实际上只是在扩展和重组现有知识，并不能开辟真正新的研究方向。
en_tdlr: By distinguishing novelty into "distance" from existing work and "direction" of inquiry, this paper finds that LLMs can extend and recombine known research but fail to open genuinely new research directions.
